metadata.title: Secure SDLC
metadata.remarks: Secure SDLC is a composite pattern asserting that software is developed, built, tested, and delivered through a governed, attributable, integrity-protected, and auditable software delivery lifecycle. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be claimed only when all constituent SDLC patterns are realized and assessed.

components.title: SDLC Core
components.description: Definition of institutional software delivery scope, models, and baseline expectations.

components.title: SDLC Identity and Attribution
components.description: Identification and attribution of software changes to responsible human and automated actors.

components.title: SDLC Change Integrity
components.description: Authorization, review, and integrity protection of software changes across delivery pipelines.

components.title: SDLC Supply Chain
components.description: Identification, risk evaluation, and provenance tracking of third-party software components.

components.title: SDLC Assurance
components.description: Embedded security assurance activities and evidence generation within the delivery lifecycle.

components.title: SDLC Operations Handover
components.description: Controlled transition of verified software artifacts and assurance context into operations.
